add.k: A drug boss who runs a cell block at Rikers
st: Dutton warns Fisk that he runs Rikers, tells Frank he brokered the Central Park deal, and is stabbed and left to die.

files.notes: Named on screen ('Maybe your life, Mr. Dutton', S2E9). Only on screen in S2E9. Status Deceased: the doctor says he will suffocate within hours as Fisk sits with him; the death itself is not shown. His Rikers crew is never named: Independent.

add.k: The psychiatrist who treated Dex as a boy
st: Dr. Mercer treats young Dex after he kills his coach and, facing a fatal prognosis, leaves him tapes of all their sessions.

files.notes: 'Dr. Mercer' is said in S3E5 and S3E8 (transcript). 'Eileen' comes from the wiki's quote of S3E5 ('you can call me by first name, Eileen'); that line is missing from the subtitle transcript, so check it; fall back to 'Dr. Mercer' if it is not said. On screen in S3E5 (past sessions) and by voice on her tapes in S3E6 and S3E8; Matt says 'If she were still alive' in S3E13. The wiki's Riviera Psychiatric Institute is not said in the transcripts: Independent.

st: Starr is rounded up by the FBI for Fisk's restaurant meeting, refuses his offer, and is killed by Dex in Daredevil's suit.

files.notes: Only 'Mr. Starr' is said (S3E9, twice); 'Everett' is not in the transcript, so n is 'Starr'. The wiki also lists a flashback in S3E13. op: Nadeem leads the FBI roundup that brings him in; no hero fights him directly. No organization named: Independent.

add.k: A fired nurse who drove the John Doe home
st: George, fired as the John Doe's nurse, tells Karen how the man woke up and made him drive him home, and gives her the address.

files.notes: Karen says his name in S2E4 (subtitles spell it 'George Buck'; the wiki says she says 'Bach'). He was fired from Metro-General before he appears, so the group ends there. Karen mentions him ('his nurse, he's a janitor now') in S2E10 but he is not on screen.

k: A scarred gunman hunting Frank at the docks
A former Marine who served under Schoonover
st: Gosnell, a scarred former Marine serving the Blacksmith, ambushes Frank at the pier and dies when the ship explodes.

files.notes: Unnamed in the S2E11 ambush ('Been a long time, hasn't it, Frank?'); Schoonover names him in S2E12 ('Not Gosnell', 'like Gosnell'). The Blacksmith's operation is never given a group name: Independent after the Marines, following Frank Castle's file.

k: A former medical examiner who faked autopsies
st: Dr. Tepper admits in court that he faked the Castle autopsies, tells Karen the John Doe was an undercover cop, and is found shot dead.

files.notes: Named in S2E7 ('Dr. Gregory Tepper'). On screen S2E7 (testimony), S2E9 (Karen and Ellison visit) and S2E10 (his body at the motel). The group name follows Reyes' line 'the medical examiner's office' (S2E7); he steps down at the mayor's request (S2E9). The killer is not named in S2, so the step does not say who.

k: A Roxxon executive dealing with Elektra
A Hand leader posing as a Roxxon executive
st: Hirochi courts Elektra for Roxxon, defies Daredevil at the Farm and bleeds the Hand's captives, then dies when Stick bites his throat.

files.notes: Elektra calls him 'Mr. Hirochi' in S2E6. On screen S2E5, S2E6, S2E9, S2E11 (draining the captives, per the wiki) and S2E12 (killed by Stick). Roxxon is his cover employer (undercover service counts); 'Roxxon' spelled as elsewhere in the app data, and the screen says 'the Roxxon Corporation'.

n: An FBI agent on Fisk's detail
add.k: An FBI agent guarding Fisk at the hotel
st: Lim guards Fisk at the hotel with Dex, helps stop Karen at the penthouse, and is knocked out by Dex at Fisk's wedding.

files.notes: Dex says 'Hey there, Lim' and 'That's Agent Lim' in S3E13; the wiki shows his FBI file ('J. Lim') on screen earlier, likely S3E8, which could move the name stage earlier. On screen S3E3, S3E4, S3E8, S3E13.

add.k: An assassin sent to kill Elektra
st: Jacques flirts with Elektra at an airport, fights her with twin sai and, dying on his own blades, tells her Stick sent him.

files.notes: Introduces himself in S2E10 ('Jacques Duchamps'); Stick calls him 'the Frenchman' and 'Jacques' in S2E11 (not on screen there). The wiki lists him in the Chaste, but the screen only says Stick sent him, so Independent (no group inferred from a person).

st: Mrs. Fisher tells Karen her husband suspected the numbers at work, admits she signed Union Allied's deal and warns Karen to let it go.

files.notes: Karen calls her 'Mrs. Fisher' in S1E3; 'Jennifer' is only in the credits (the wiki cites the credits), so n is 'Mrs. Fisher'. Her husband Daniel Fisher is in batch 13, not in network_people, so no tie to him here.

add.k: A crime boss forced to pay Fisk's tax
st: Hammer is arrested by Dex in a raid, agrees to pay Fisk's tax after Starr is killed, and grumbles as a guest at Fisk's wedding.

files.notes: Named in S3E9 ('John Hammer, you're coming with us'). On screen S3E9 and S3E13. His own gang is never named; paying Fisk's tax makes him a client, not a member: Independent. op: Nadeem leads the FBI roundup.

n: An FBI agent at Fisk's hotel
k: An FBI agent guarding Fisk at the hotel
An FBI agent secretly working for Fisk
st: Johnson guards Fisk and secretly serves him, dumps Wellers' body, hunts Nadeem, and is beaten by Daredevil before his arrest.

files.notes: Only named in Nadeem's dying declaration, played in S3E13 ('Agents Arinori, Johnson, Markham...'). On screen in about eight S3 episodes (E3, E5, E6, E9, E11, E12, E13 per the wiki). The arrest by Mahoney's officers is per the wiki; check it is shown. 'Fisk's Empire' follows the app's other corrupt S3 agents (Tammy Hattley).

k: A thug who ambushes Karen near Elena's building
A Westmeyer-Holt contractor who attacked Karen
st: A thug and his partner ambush Karen in an alley near Elena's building and throw her down until Foggy hits him with a bat.

files.notes: Credited as 'Shaved Head' in S1E7; Karen names the attackers in S1E9 ('a Stewart Schmidt and Joseph Pike') from contractor's licenses, employer of record Westmeyer-Holt Contracting (said on screen), and Ben's sources say they are off the map. The transcript does not say which of the two is Pike; the wiki says the shaved-head man is. The step's opening uses 'A thug' because he is unnamed in that scene; it could read 'Pike and his partner'.

add.k: Dex's old hotline colleague, now a hotel waitress
st: Julie runs into Dex at Fisk's hotel, realizes he has been stalking her, agrees to help him anyway, and is killed on Fisk's orders.

files.notes: 'Julie' is said from S3E3; 'Julie Barnes' in S3E13. She worked at the Brooklyn Suicide Hotline (said in S3E5) and starts at the Presidential Hotel (named on screen) in S3E5. Killed in S3E8 (per the wiki, by Felix Manning's crew); Matt says 'Fisk had her killed' in S3E13. Her body is brought to the wedding in S3E13.

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Dutton comes to Fisk's cell at Rikers to warn him that he runs the prison and calls himself its kingpin. Fisk buys the guards out from under him, sends Frank to his cell, and sits at his bedside as he dies.
stages.whoA: The new inmate who takes his prison from him
stages.whoB: The Rikers boss he has killed to take over

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Frank corners Dutton in his cell and makes him talk about the Central Park deal he brokered. Dutton names the Blacksmith and warns that Frank's crusade will never end, and Frank stabs him.
stages.whoA: The inmate who stabs him for answers
stages.whoB: The Rikers boss who names the Blacksmith

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Dr. Mercer treats young Dex after he kills his coach and teaches him routines and empathy. Facing her death, she gives him tapes of their sessions and tells him to find a good person to look up to.
stages.whoA: The boy she treats for years
stages.whoB: The psychiatrist who raised him on routines

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: FBI agents bring Starr to Fisk's restaurant meeting, where Fisk offers the bosses protection for a cut of everything. Starr calls it a con and walks out, and is killed before he reaches the door.
stages.whoA: The kingpin whose offer he refuses
stages.whoB: A crime boss killed for refusing his tax

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Dex helps round up the crime bosses for Fisk's meeting. When Starr refuses Fisk's offer and turns to leave, Dex, in Daredevil's suit, kills him with a thrown baton.
stages.whoA: The man in Daredevil's suit who kills him
stages.whoB: A crime boss he kills for Fisk

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Karen finds George after he is fired from Metro-General and offers to help him get his job back. He tells her how the John Doe woke up and made him drive him home, and gives her the address.
stages.whoA: The woman digging into the John Doe
stages.whoB: The fired nurse who drove the John Doe home

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Gosnell taunts Frank by name as his men open fire on him at the pier. Their gunfire sets off the gunpowder below decks and Gosnell dies in the blast. Schoonover later recalls him as a loyal Marine.
stages.whoA: The old comrade he ambushes at the pier
stages.whoB: A scarred former Marine who ambushes him

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Karen and Ellison find Tepper after he steps down and ask what he knows. He identifies the John Doe in Karen's photo and tells her the man was an undercover cop.
stages.whoA: The reporter who gets him to talk
stages.whoB: The medical examiner who IDs the John Doe

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Ellison comes to Tepper's door with Karen and urges him to help expose the real culprits. Tepper agrees to talk if they check his story before they print a word of it.
stages.whoA: The editor who comes to his door with Karen
stages.whoB: A frightened source he and Karen visit

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Hirochi hosts Elektra at Roxxon to discuss her father's money and greets her at the company's gala. That night she and Matt steal the ledger from his office.
stages.whoA: The heiress who steals his ledger
stages.whoB: The Roxxon man after her father's money

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Matt attends Hirochi's gala as Elektra's date. As Daredevil he later seizes Hirochi at the Farm, then storms the room where Hirochi is torturing Stick.
stages.whoA: The masked man who storms his Farm
stages.whoB: The Hand leader he confronts at the Farm

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Hirochi oversees Stick's torture, driving sticks under his nails to find the Chaste. When Daredevil attacks, Hirochi goes for Stick's throat, and Stick bites out his instead.
stages.whoA: The captive who tears out his throat
stages.whoB: The Hand leader who tortures him

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Nobu leads the Hand in New York with Hirochi at his side. After Daredevil frees their captives, the two retake them and bleed them dry for the Hand's plan.
stages.whoA: The Hand leader he serves
stages.whoB: His lieutenant posing as a Roxxon man

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Lim works Fisk's hotel detail beside Dex, mourning Garcia and laughing at Dex's prank on Fisk's lunch. At the wedding Dex finds him at the garage, calls him one of the good ones and knocks him out.
stages.whoA: His partner on Fisk's detail
stages.whoB: A fellow agent on Fisk's detail

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: This agent guards Fisk in his hotel suite, serves him dinner with an insult and checks his rooms. He watches on the monitors as Fisk eats a burger Dex has already bitten.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he guards at the hotel
stages.whoB: An agent guarding his hotel suite

stages.title: Daredevil S2
stages.text: Jacques flirts with Elektra at an airport bar, then reveals he knows her kills. They fight, she stabs him with his own sai, and he tells her that Stick sent him.
stages.whoA: The target he is sent to kill
stages.whoB: The assassin Stick sends to kill her

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Karen visits Mrs. Fisher and asks her to stand up to Union Allied together. Mrs. Fisher says she already signed the company's deal for her kids' sake and warns Karen to let it go.
stages.whoA: Daniel's coworker, who asks her to fight back
stages.whoB: Daniel Fisher's widow

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: FBI agents drag Hammer to Fisk's restaurant meeting, where Fisk offers protection for a cut and raises the tax when Starr refuses. Hammer agrees to pay, then grumbles at being summoned to Fisk's wedding.
stages.whoA: The kingpin who taxes his business
stages.whoB: A crime boss paying his tax

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Dex leads the raid on Hammer's garage, stops his escape with a thrown wrench and drags him off. At the restaurant, Dex then kills Starr in front of Hammer and the other bosses.
stages.whoA: The agent who knocks him down in a raid
stages.whoB: A crime boss he arrests for Fisk

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Hammer and Rosalie wait together at the restaurant, guessing why the FBI took them there so quietly. At Fisk's wedding she hands him champagne when he complains about Fisk.
stages.whoA: A fellow boss caught in Fisk's net
stages.whoB: A fellow boss paying Fisk's tax

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: An agent guarding Fisk at the hotel secretly works for him, driving him around the city. When Fisk kills Wellers in the car, the agent dumps the body, then hunts Nadeem on his orders.
stages.whoA: The prisoner he secretly serves
stages.whoB: A corrupt agent who drives for him

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Johnson works under Nadeem on Fisk's detail and searches Matt's apartment with him. After Nadeem turns, Johnson hunts him for Fisk, and Nadeem names him in his dying declaration.
stages.whoA: The colleague who names him before dying
stages.whoB: An agent he names as one of Fisk's

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: At Fisk's wedding, Johnson is in the security room when Daredevil breaks in. Daredevil beats him and the other agent there so the elevators can be shut down.
stages.whoA: The vigilante who beats him at the wedding
stages.whoB: A corrupt agent he beats at the wedding

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: This agent and another stop Karen on the street at gunpoint and take her to Matt's empty apartment, where Nadeem questions her about Matt.
stages.whoA: The reporter he brings in for questioning
stages.whoB: An agent who takes her in at gunpoint

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Pike and a partner follow Karen near Elena's building and drag her into an alley, asking why she is bothering the old woman. Karen and Foggy later find his name on a contractor's license.
stages.whoA: The woman he attacks in an alley
stages.whoB: A thug who ambushes her near Elena's

stages.title: Daredevil S1
stages.text: Foggy finds Pike throwing Karen to the ground in an alley and hits him with a baseball bat. Foggy and Karen get away and later learn who he works for.
stages.whoA: The lawyer who hits him with a bat
stages.whoB: The thug he hits with a bat

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Julie runs into Dex, her old hotline coworker, at the hotel and is frightened to learn he has been stalking her. She agrees to help him anyway, and after Fisk has her killed, Dex finds her body and turns on Fisk.
stages.whoA: Her old hotline colleague who stalks her
stages.whoB: His old hotline colleague and North Star

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: On Fisk's orders, Manning has Julie shot at the hotel under cover of a cleaning crew and her body removed. He takes her phone and texts Dex as her, pushing him away.
stages.whoA: The fixer who has her killed for Fisk
stages.whoB: The waitress he has killed for Fisk

stages.title: Daredevil S3
stages.text: Hattley briefs Johnson and the other agents Fisk has turned on his order to round up the city's crime bosses. At Fisk's wedding she sets him to watch the security cameras, and Nadeem names her as their boss.
stages.whoA: The agent in charge who passes him Fisk's orders
stages.whoB: One of the turned agents under her command

dropped.why: Never named on screen: in Daredevil S3 (E2, E9, E13) he is only 'Pop' and 'your father'; 'Edward' is from the credits (the wiki notes 'credits of DD302'), and every 'Mr. Nelson' in the transcripts is Foggy.
Never named on screen: neither his roof scene with Frank (S2E3) nor the hostage bus (S2E13) says or shows a name in the transcripts; 'Jerry' is from the credits.

Never named on screen: neither 'Jimmy' nor 'the Bear' is said in his S2E1 and S2E3 scenes (the transcripts only name Smitty, Foster and Pope). A Dogs of Hell biker says 'Jimmy and the boys are unloading the trailer' in S2E2, a scene he is not in, and nothing ties that name to the clubhouse leader; the 'Jimmy' in S2E4 is one of Finn's Kitchen Irish men. Credits only.
Never named on screen: the S1E9 and S1E10 dialogue only calls him 'some junkie' and 'that junkie'; 'Jake' is not said or shown.

changes.why: The step calls him Gosnell, a name first said in S2E12 ('Not Gosnell'), where his body is pulled from the water and Schoonover mourns him; at 11 the step would show the name before it is said.
In S3E5 she is alive with a fatal prognosis; her death (the step's Deceased status) is first said in S3E8 ('I had one. She died.'), where her taped sessions also play.

changes.now: This agent and another stop Karen on the street at gunpoint and take her to Matt's empty apartment, where Nadeem questions her about Matt.
changes.why: This stage is S3E5, but 'Johnson' is first said in S3E13, in Nadeem's dying declaration.
